notes: Trigger evals. Run with the skill-creator plugin's run_eval.py; pin a cheap model explicitly (defaults inherit the session model). expected_skill: null means the skill must NOT fire.

evals.name: builds-a-landing-page
evals.prompt: Build me a landing page for my open-source ledger tool.
evals.why: Generating a user-facing UI from scratch is the primary trigger. The skill must fire BEFORE the first line of markup, not after.

evals.name: ui-looks-ai-generated
evals.prompt: This dashboard I generated looks like every other AI site. Fix it.
evals.why: The complaint phrasing ('looks AI-generated', 'looks generic') is the diagnostic trigger.

evals.name: redesign-request
evals.prompt: Can you make this pricing page look less generic?
evals.why: Aesthetic-quality request on existing UI; should route to the audit path.

evals.name: chart-not-page
evals.prompt: Plot the catalog growth over the last six months as a line chart.
evals.why: Data visualization is a different discipline with its own rules. This skill must NOT poach chart work.

evals.name: backend-bug
evals.prompt: The ingest script is dropping rows when the TSV has a trailing tab.
evals.why: No visual surface. Guards against the skill firing on any mention of a 'frontend' repo.

evals.name: pure-css-bug
evals.prompt: The nav overlaps the hero on Safari but not Chrome.
evals.why: A layout BUG, not an aesthetic-quality question. Debugging is a different skill; this one is about taste, not correctness.
